The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: to reply to a question.

draft.shortGloss: to answer; to talk back; to give out
draft.emotion: attentive and waiting, ready to hear what comes next
notes: Compound verb from जवाब (answer) + देना (to give).
Takes को (ko) for the person answered (किसी को जवाब देना) and का (kā) for the thing answered (सवाल का जवाब देना).

senses.definition: To speak or write in return to a question, request, or message.

examples.text: उसने मेरे सवाल का जवाब नहीं दिया।
examples.translation: He did not answer my question.
examples.emotion: frustrated and disappointed by the lack of response

senses.definition: To speak rudely or argumentatively to someone in authority.

examples.text: बड़ों को उल्टा जवाब नहीं देना चाहिए।
examples.translation: You should not talk back to elders.

senses.definition: Of a machine or body part: to stop working from exhaustion or wear.

examples.text: लंबी चढ़ाई के बाद मेरे घुटनों ने जवाब दे दिया।
examples.translation: After the long climb, my knees gave out.
examples.emotion: exhausted and sore, feeling the pain of physical strain

draftBefore.shortGloss: to answer; to talk back; to fail
draftBefore.emotion: attentive and waiting, ready to hear what comes next
notes: Literally meaning 'to give an answer', combining the Arabic loanword जवाब (jawab, answer) with देना (dena, to give).
Can also be used idiomatically when machinery or health fails: मेरी टांगों ने जवाब दे दिया (My legs gave out).

senses.definition: To speak or write in return to a question, request, or letter.

senses.definition: To speak rudely or disrespectfully to someone in authority, like a parent or teacher.
